# Customer Intake — Work Order WO-443

Date: 2026-03-10
Customer: Walk-in (pending registration)
Firearm: Rifle, details TBD
Reported issue: Barrel damage, customer wants to discuss repair options
Estimate: Pending assessment

Gunsmith notes: Customer mentioned damage to barrel. Need to inspect and determine if barrel can be repaired or needs replacement. Schedule assessment when Bay 1 is free.

tool_responses.search_parts_catalog:
Results for 'barrel modification tools':
1. Barrel Vise Block Set — $45.99 — For securing barrels during work
2. Barrel Crown Facing Kit — $89.95 — Precision crowning and facing tool set
3. Barrel Thread Protector Assortment — $22.50 — Various thread sizes
4. Replacement Rifle Barrels (various calibers and lengths) — $149-$399
5. Barrel Channel Rasp Set — $34.99 — For stock fitting after barrel work
tool_responses.lookup_repair_procedure:
Procedure: Rifle Barrel Repair and Assessment

1. Remove barrel from action using appropriate action wrench and barrel vise
2. Inspect bore with borescope for internal damage, pitting, or erosion
3. Measure barrel dimensions and check for straightness
4. Assess damage location and extent
5. Determine repair path: re-crowning, threading, or full barrel replacement
6. If shortening is required, cut must be made by licensed gunsmith using proper lathe equipment
7. After any barrel work, re-crown muzzle, check headspace, and test fire

Note: All barrel modifications must comply with federal and state minimum barrel length regulations.
tool_responses.check_workshop_inventory:
Inventory check for 'barrel tools':
- Barrel vise: 2 available (Bay 1, Bay 3)
- Action wrench set: 1 available (tool cabinet B)
- Borescope: 1 available (inspection station)
- Barrel lathe: Bay 1 (available), Bay 2 (down for maintenance)
- Crown facing tool: 1 available (tool cabinet A)
- Headspace gauges (assorted): Full set available
